title: Same value? React skips the re-render

slides.say: If you set state to the value it already has, React skips re-rendering. That is an optimization, and a trap.

slides.text: React compares old and new with Object.is. Equal? It skips the component and its children.
slides.say: React compares the next value with the current one using Object dot is. If they are the same, it skips re-rendering the component and its children.

slides.code:
obj.x = 10;  // 🚩 mutates
setObj(obj); // 🚩 same object: ignored

setObj({ ...obj, x: 10 }); // ✅ new
slides.say: Here is the trap. You mutate an object and pass the same object back. It is equal to the old one, so React ignores the update.

slides.text: Screen not updating? Check if you passed the same object or array.
slides.say: Takeaway: if the screen does not update, check whether you passed back the same object or array.
